about.title: About Us
about.aboutText1: With many years of experience accompanying businesses and units in the technology field, PalmTek is proud to bring advanced technology solutions, helping to optimize performance, improve operational efficiency and contribute to the overall development of the organization and the country.
about.aboutText2: We focus on core solutions such as digital transformation using AI, smart monitoring devices, cloud computing, security, smart payments, digital banking and finance, along with 'Made by Vietnam' solutions bearing the mark of domestic technology.
about.aboutText3: PalmTek – a trusted partner for effective and safe digital transformation.

2007.title: Establishment of VIEGRID
2007.content: In 2007, VIEGRID Company was established, marking the beginning of the pioneering journey in the field of information technology and digital transformation in Vietnam. This is the predecessor of PalmTek Innovation Joint Stock Company, laying the foundation for the innovative and effective solutions that the company pursues later.

2008.title: Translation Innovation with VIEGRID
content: Provide software products for employee tracking for companies in Singapore.
Develop English-Vietnamese translation solution BOCOHAN V-LANG.

2009.title: Remote Work System Project
2009.content: Implement the project to build a safe remote work system via the Internet for the People's Committee of Quang Ninh province - The project that originated ideas about network security and V-AZUR.

2010.title: Release of BOCOHAN/V-LANG Solution
content: - Complete development of BOCOHAN/V-LANG translation solution with Chinese version.
- Provide BOCOHAN/V-LANG for World Bank translation project, Vietnam News Agency, VTC Digital Television to support the translation and broadcasting process.
- The V-AZUR network security solution completed the research and development phase.

2012.title: V-AZUR Product Testing
content: The High-Tech Crime Prevention and Control Bureau (C50) conducted testing of V-AZUR products according to the cooperation categories between C50, Institute of Information Technology - VNU, VIEGRID.
C50 evaluated the level of network security for the solution according to Official Dispatch No. 1675/C50-P1.

2013.title: Release of V-AZUR Solution
content: Provide V-AZUR to the Informatics Department - Ministry of Finance; Information Center - Ministry of Construction, General Department of Archives; Banking Informatics Department - State Bank & Department of Science and Technology - Ministry of Industry and Trade.

Provide business software for Department of Information and Communications of Hanoi, Thua Thien Hue, Ho Chi Minh City, Office of Quang Ninh Provincial People's Committee, Ministry of Industry and Trade, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Construction...

2015.title: Sao Khue Award
2015.content: In 2015, VIEGRID Communications and Technology Joint Stock Company was honored to receive the Sao Khue Award for the V-AZUR solution, affirming its position in the field of network security. The product is evaluated by creative and effective experts, contributing to improving information security for businesses and state agencies.

2019.title: Network Information Security Solution
2019.content: VIEGRID was granted a license to trade in network information security products and services under the 2015 Network Information Security Law. The license confirms that VIEGRID is eligible to provide network security solutions, enhancing credibility and contributing to information security in Vietnam.

2020.title: Development of V-TRANSFORM Solution
2020.content: VIEGRID cooperates to develop the V-TRANSFORM Digital Transformation Solution set for ministries, branches, and state agencies.

2023.title: Release of V-LAKE Solution
2023.content: VIEGRID has successfully researched, developed and applied the V-LAKE Data Platform, a modern data lake model big data storage solution, allowing integration of raw, semi-structured and structured data from various sources. This platform supports real-time data analysis, AI/ML applications and ensures information security according to national standards, contributing to improving the efficiency of digital transformation for Vietnamese organizations and businesses.

2025.title: PalmTek - A New Chapter
2025.content: In 2025, VIEGRID officially changed its name to PalmTek, marking a new development phase with a focus on expanding technology and information security solutions. This change not only reflects the brand repositioning strategy but also aims to enhance international competitiveness, continuing to support digital transformation for state agencies and businesses in Vietnam.
